key_insight: Grounding both the input video and new camera trajectories in a single 4D (space + time) point cloud lets Vista4D re-synthesize the same scene dynamics from arbitrary viewpoints with improved robustness to depth artifacts and precise camera control.
problem_solved: Existing video reshooting methods fail on real-world dynamic videos due to depth-estimation artifacts, poor appearance preservation, and limited camera control; Vista4D solves these by representing spatio-temporal content explicitly as a 4D point cloud for more stable, controllable resynthesis.
method: Construct a 4D spatio-temporal point cloud from the input video that encodes geometry, color, and temporal dynamics.
Associate target camera trajectories and viewpoints with the 4D cloud to sample/render the scene from new perspectives while keeping original motion intact.
Apply robust depth fusion/completion and appearance-preserving rendering on the 4D representation to reduce artifacts and enable precise camera control during reshooting.
impact: Vista4D enables realistic, controllable view synthesis of dynamic real-world videos, improving workflows in video editing, virtual production, and data generation for vision models by providing artifact-resistant reshooting and exact camera manipulation.

paper_title: Vista4D: Video Reshooting with 4D Point Clouds
paper_authors: Kuan Heng Lin, Zhizheng Liu, Pablo Salamanca, Yash Kant, Ryan Burgert
